title: Manimuthu, Dattu Crowned National Singles Champions
indian_angle: Indian young talents Manimuthu and Dattu have secured significant domestic titles, showcasing the depth of future Indian badminton.
summary: Manimuthu successfully defended her girls' singles title, defeating Lakshya 15-10, 15-12, while Dattu claimed the boys' singles crown at the national championships.

title: Satwik-Chirag Bow Out of Hong Kong Open Semifinals
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, faced a tough defeat in the Hong Kong Open semifinals, ending their strong run.
summary: The world No. 6 Indian pair lost 18-21, 19-21 to Malaysia's Man Wei Chong and Tee Kai Wun, concluding their campaign at the Hong Kong Open.

title: Lakshya Sen, Satwik-Chirag Advance to Hong Kong Open Semifinals
indian_angle: Indian stars Lakshya Sen and the pair of Satwik-Chirag showed strong form by securing their spots in the Hong Kong Open semifinals.
summary: Lakshya Sen won 21-17, 10-21, 21-13, while Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty also triumphed to reach the penultimate round of the tournament.

title: 88th Senior National Badminton Championships Set for Bhubaneswar
indian_angle: The premier domestic badminton event, the 88th Senior National Badminton Championships, will be hosted in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, attracting top Indian talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced that the 79th Inter State – Inter Zonal & 88th Senior National Badminton Championships 2026 will take place in Bhubaneswar from December 17th to 24th, 2026.

title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Junior Championships Underway
indian_angle: India's promising young shuttlers are undergoing intensive training at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: A national coaching camp has been organized at NCE, Guwahati, to prepare the Indian contingent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026, focusing on nurturing future talent.
